name: Midland
notes: Offered to this section outright by `country-pop` and taken here because their default groove is a shuffle: a trio playing the 1980s New Traditionalist template with California harmony over a Bakersfield two-beat. The entry's most distinctive stated parameter is the tempo — "BPM 71–110 … notably slow for a shuffle band, which is the entry's most distinctive parameter: the shuffle here is a mid-slow one, not a dancehall one" — so bpm runs 71–110 with mode 102 ("Drinkin' Problem"), and the swing is set wide at 0.68 because the section's own grammar states the ratio is "wider at slower tempos". The drums are the entry's line item by item: "a shuffled two-beat with the triplet lope on a closed hat, kick on 1 and 3" (kick pinned to 2 with the two-beat anchors and syncopation down to 0.06), "snare dry and mid-forward" (velocity tiers 98–116 over 72–88), "no crash-heavy chorus lift — the dynamic staging that modern radio country uses is deliberately absent, which is the point of the band" (fills out to 8/16 bars, transitions.fillBeforeSection false and switchUpProb 0.08), and cross-stick on the slowest cuts (the rim lane joined to the inherited ride). Harmony is I–IV–V with V7 and a ii–V turnaround, with the sourced yacht-rock/Eagles borrowings read as "major-7th and add9 voicings sitting inside an otherwise plain honky-tonk progression" — that is extensions 0.5/0.36/0.14, not new numerals. The lead is the documented "relaxed mid-baritone … narrow range, long sustained notes with a slow scoop into pitch, low ornament density", and pedal steel is stated to be the lead colour, which is the timbre hint. Three-part close California harmony sits in the counter as a sustain-heavy style pair at a low density ratio, deliberately not an octave away. ⚠ INFERRED: swing.amount, all velocity tiers, ghost probability, the hat and percs densities and the counter's density ratio. ⚠ Confidence is medium because the research splits it: medium-high on style, lineup, producers and certification, but medium-low on tempo — "only three readings were reachable", and those readings are bpmdatabase values, [LOW-CONF] as a class.
